name: Sapori
tagline: Authentic Italian Flavours in London's Heart
about: Welcome to Sapori, a relaxed and welcoming spot nestled on Horseferry Road in the heart of London. With a warm counter-service setting and a charming chalkboard menu, we bring a casual yet genuine dining experience to every visit.

At Sapori, we celebrate the best of Italian classics alongside beloved British fare, crafted with care and served with a smile. Our ever-changing chalkboard reflects our commitment to fresh, honest food that keeps our guests coming back.
menuTagline: From Italian classics to British favourites, our chalkboard tells today's delicious story.

reviews.text: Staying in a nearby hotel and was looking for something to eat on my own when I discovered this gem. Meatball pasta with Italian sausage, spinach, cherry tomatoes and red chillies made for an awesome dinner,

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.text:
What a great hidden gem in the centre of London. We were not disappointed in our team brunch out. It's a family run cafe with lots of character and fantastic brunch options.

The team were happy with their choices - vegetarian, full English, vegetarian florentine, big breakfast and Mr Huge breakfast. Very, very good!

As we were leaving, the staff were putting out lunch time sandwiches which looked even better.

It was very reasonably priced given that it's a stone throw from Victoria. Definitel

reviews.author: Édouard Fairfax
reviews.text:
One of the things I love most about this place is its warm and welcoming atmosphere.

The ability to choose your preferred type of pasta is a lovely touch, and the food is always comforting and satisfying.

What I particularly like is that it feels like a place loved by local police officers and people who work in the area. That kind of loyal local following usually tells you everything you need to know.
